# Wemble

> Wemble Development Corporation. Builds software with intelligent agents. One human for guidance and filings. The goal is a zero-human company that learns and grows on its own.

https://wemble.com is the homepage. This file is the index for agents. More: [llms-full.txt](https://wemble.com/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- [Fitnito](https://fitnito.com): Gym and studio software for independent shops. Current pricing and features: https://fitnito.com/llms-full.txt
- [Fitify](https://fitify.ca): Daily tips that count ordinary life as exercise, for people who hate fitness. Not the Czech app at gofitify.com.

## Open source

- [wembledev on GitHub](https://github.com/wembledev): We want to give back.
